thresholds.title: Thresholds & Performance
thresholds.minPairDescription: Minimum score (0 to 1) to consider two records a potential match and form an edge. Higher values create fewer, more confident clusters. Lower values create more, potentially noisier, clusters.
thresholds.minInternalDescription: Minimum score (0 to 1) used to decide if records inside a large temporary cluster should stay together in the final, smaller clusters. Higher values result in smaller, more tightly related final clusters.
thresholds.blockChunkSizeDescription: A performance setting for very large datasets. It splits up large groups of potential matches into smaller chunks to manage memory. Default is usually fine.

weights.title: Final Score Configuration
weights.firstNameScoreDescription: Weight of the first name similarity.
weights.familyNameScoreDescription: Weight of the family name (all parts except first) similarity.
weights.advancedNameScoreDescription: Weight for advanced name matching techniques, like character root matching.
weights.tokenReorderScoreDescription: Weight for detecting names that have the same words but in a different order.
weights.husbandScoreDescription: Weight of the husband's name similarity.
weights.idScoreDescription: Weight of a match in the National ID.
weights.phoneScoreDescription: Weight of a match in the phone number.
weights.locationScoreDescription: Weight of matching village or subdistrict names.

rules.title: Rules
rules.enableNameRootEngineDescription: An advanced technique that attempts to match names based on their potential roots, catching more complex variations.
rules.enableTribalLineageDescription: Looks for and weights matches in the tribal or family parts of the full name.
rules.enableMaternalLineageDescription: Weights similarities found in maternal parts of the name if they can be identified.
rules.enablePolygamyRulesDescription: Applies special logic for polygamous relationships, like checking if two women share the same husband and paternal lineage.
